heading: About
intro: I'm Sabarna Barik — some people call me Rico.
body: I'm a Computer Science student who learns best by building things end to end. Rather than collecting concepts in isolation, I turn each one into something working — a script, an API, a small system — and keep the ones that hold up under real use.

So far that journey has taken me through web development with Python and Flask, relational databases, and the fundamentals that hold it all together: data structures, algorithms, and clean engineering discipline. Every project here is a checkpoint of what I understood at that moment.

I believe learning is compounding: learn the fundamentals, build something real, ship it, document it, and let the next project be better than the last. This site is exactly that loop — the documented output of my own process.
philosophy: Building real things to learn, and learning to build better.
